feeds.title: Rockford Bands
feeds.description: The Rockford Public Schools proudly supports an award-winning band program. Band students have the opportunity to perform at local concerts, attend district and state band festivals, and can participate in small ensembles or as soloists. All students are encouraged to take private lessons. The weekly 30-minute lesson in a one-on-one setting will greatly improve your student's success in class.

feeds.title: West Deptford HS Marching Band Blog
feeds.description: West Deptford HS Marching Band Blog posts about events, schedules, performances, reviews, and more. The blog also has an online store, where you can buy merchandise from this band.

feeds.title: Cville Band Blog
feeds.description: Cville Band Blog documents the history of the band, writes about artists, keeps you updated on upcoming events, allows you to shop, and more.

feeds.title: Voxitatis Blog » Marching Band
feeds.description: In this blog, you will find commentary on school news in the fine arts, academics, marching band, and athletics. This site operates a news service in order to disseminate information, most of which we hope can be positive and put to good use in the service of educating students, especially those in public schools in Maryland and Illinois.

feeds.title: Jenison Bands Blog
feeds.description: Jenison Bands Blog writes about the event performances of this band, from parking spaces to schedules, food, tickets, and more.

feeds.title: BOX5-TV
feeds.description: Watch marching videos and news, competitions and live Streaming only on BOX5-TV.

feeds.title: The Marching Virginians
feeds.description: Since their creation in 1974, The Marching Virginians have performed for hundreds of nationally televised football games and parades. Members of The Marching Virginians include students from all walks of life and majors across the university. Competitive auditions are open to all Virginia Tech students - even graduate students.

feeds.title: Jeff Chambers Music Blog
feeds.description: Born in Issaquah, Washington in 1990, Jeff Chambers grew up in eastern Washington and now composes and arranges music that is played and heard around the world. He is the owner and leads brass and percussion arranger for Jeff Chambers Music LLC. Jeff has composed and arranged over 130 new marching band shows and has received national recognition as a prominent and emerging marching arts designer. In this blog, he documents his music and experience.

feeds.title: Downers Grove North High School Bands
feeds.description: Downers Grove North High School Bands' blog keeps you posted on their day-to-day activities, their parties, performances, band members, and more.

feeds.title: HornRank
feeds.description: HornRank is the premiere national scholastic marching band rankings website, focused on covering the best high school bands and band competitions in the United States. It exists to positively impact music education in the United States by promoting the marching arts and encouraging competition and innovation through a national rankings system.

feeds.title: School of Music » Marching Band
feeds.description: Read the student stories on marching bands, band students share their experiences and more. the Humans of the School of Music project was created to share the stories of our students, faculty, and staff here at Ball State.

feeds.title: Richland County H.S. Bands
feeds.description: Richland County H.S. Bands is a video blog that showcases the work of this band. The blog belongs to Richland County High School. Every performance of this band can be found on this blog page.
